correctness.rationale: Fourier Laurent coefficients are precisely Gaussian-integer aperiodic correlations, and 2n-1 equally spaced intensity samples determine them. Normalizing a_0=1 yields exactly 4^(n-1) phase classes. The conjugate-reversal involution on normalized exponents is e_j -> e_(n-1)-e_(n-1-j) mod 4. An independently written exact-integer exhaustive census classified every such sequence for n=1..6: numbers of spectra 1,4,10,40,136,540 and orbit classes 1,4,10,40,136,544. At n=6 it found precisely 536 singleton and four doubleton spectral buckets, no larger bucket; all four are modulations of the exhibited binary/four-phase pair. The submitted Gaussian-integer polynomial factor flip verifies the witness analytically. Since the domain n<=6 is fully exhausted, the finite enumeration is complete proof for that stated finite domain, not for n>=7.
